name: Norconsult ASA
summary: Norconsult ASA provides consultancy services with focus on community planning, engineering design, and architecture in Nordics, Sweden, Denmark, Europe, and internationally. It offers consultancy services for the planning and engineering design of construction and real estate projects, such as residential, office, and industrial buildings; hospitals, healthcare buildings, and care homes; schools and educational buildings; sports facilities; cultural buildings; laboratory buildings, terminal buildings for airports and railway stations; and fire and police stations.
